name: Multi-Stage Rasterization for Shaded Isosurfaces
definition: An adaptation of the Fast Shaded Isosurfaces method for PC hardware using multi-stage rasterization and 2D-textures, enabling efficient rendering of shaded isosurfaces.
summary: Multi-Stage Rasterization for Shaded Isosurfaces uses a two-pass register combiner pipeline to efficiently render shaded isosurfaces on PC hardware, replacing iterative ray-marching with interpolated voxel gradients and dot-product lighting.
